settings.autoPasteDesc: Opens a preview when enabled rules change the pasted content. Does not trigger in code or math contexts.

settings.maxCharsDesc: Uses Obsidian’s native paste when this limit is exceeded.

settings.keyMissing: Not configured. Keys are saved using Obsidian SecretStorage.
settings.keyPlaceholder: Enter a key to save it
settings.imageModelDesc: Enter the vision model name or ID. Used when smart conversion input contains images, including any accompanying text.
settings.textModelDesc: Enter the text model name or ID. Used when smart conversion input contains only text.
settings.promptDesc: System prompt. Changes take effect the next time you send a request.
settings.promptSaveFailed: EasyPaste: Failed to save the prompt. Please try again.

rule.spellingDesc: Converts common British and American spellings
rule.listsDesc: Normalizes list markers, nesting and continuation-line indentation.

rule.flagsDesc: For example: g replaces all matches, i ignores case, m enables multiline matching, and s matches across lines. Leave blank to replace only the first match.
